item.title: Marjorie Harmon – PENDING
item.description: Marjorie Harmon, 73, Warsaw, died Saturday, Feb. 7, 2026, at Parkview Regional Medical Center, Fort Wayne. Arrangements are pending at Titus Funeral Home & Cremation Services, Warsaw.

item.title: Bill Would Allow $1 State Park Gate Fee Hike
item.description: House Bill 1204, approved Monday, Feb. 9 by the House, would permit counties to adopt ordinances adding a $1 surcharge per vehicle at qualifying state parks and recreation areas.

item.title: Firefighters Respond To Garage Fire on South Packerton Road In Warsaw
item.description: A house fire originating at the garage caused damage at 1948 S. Packerton Road, Warsaw, Sunday evening, Feb. 8.

item.title: Amazon To Open Vincennes Delivery Station
item.description: Amazon plans to expand its logistics network in Indiana with a new delivery station in Vincennes, a project expected to bring jobs and faster shipping to Knox County and surrounding communities, according to a company announcement issued Monday, Feb. 5.

item.title: Warsaw Library Board Hears Update On Upcoming Holocaust Exhibit
item.description: The Warsaw Community Public Library Board of Trustees heard about a cohort meeting with other libraries during a brief meeting on Monday, Feb. 9.

item.title: Fort Wayne Housing Authority Opens Housing Complex For Homeless
item.description: The Fort Wayne Housing Authority today celebrated the opening of Hillcrest Commons, a multimillion dollar permanent supportive housing development designed to serve adults experiencing chronic homelessness and other at risk individuals.

item.title: L.I.T.E. Opens New Teen Space, Offers Support And Community
item.description: Monday evening, Feb. 9 marked the official opening of R.I.S.E. Teen Space at 109 W. Catherine St., Milford - L.I.T.E. Recovery's new space for teens to hang out, share struggles and find community.

item.title: Leesburg opts out of CAP
item.description: Leesburg Town Council has opted out, for now, of submitting a letter of intent for the Community Amenity Program.
